rationale: When topk==1 with post-softmax, softmax of length-1 vector is constant 1.0 with zero gradient. Detectable at build by asserting NOT(topk==1 AND use_pre_softmax==False) on TopKRouter (precond). Single-GPU MoE reproduces, so parallel_dim=none (anti-example 6). Borderline numerical vs moe: chose moe because the bug is specific to MoE router topk algorithm. P8 over P5 because static config check is cheaper than runtime grad-norm probe.
